caption:
Beam shuttering ke liye baar baar nayi ply lene ki tension khatam kijiye.

VAJRA PP shuttering sheet circular cutter se aasaani se cut jaati hai aur sahi handling ke saath ply se 2-3 guna zyada chalti hai. Har dhalai ka kharcha ply se kam!
